title: Irreducible non-holonomic modules for rational Cherednik algebras
summary: Let $\mathbb{K}$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero and let $A_n(\mathbb{K})$ be the $n$-th Weyl algebra. We prove that for every complex reflection group $G$ and every $n \geq 2$ the ring of invariant differential operators $A_n(\mathbb{K})^G$ has irreducible non-holonomic modules of Gelfand-Kirillov dimension $2n-1$, and we exhibit such modules explicitly.
